name: Perps PnL withdrawal → UK, Saturday 03:12
sub: A trader on an onshore venue withdraws realised PnL on a weekend night.

source.description: USDC 12,400.00 realised PnL · positions closed 02:58 UTC
source.note: Lineage: deposits USD 9,000 (2 legs) + realised gains USD 3,400

facts.sourceOfFunds: deposits + realised PnL reconcile to venue statement
facts.attestation: venue attestation of realised PnL (positions closed 02:58 UTC)

narratives.APPROVED: It is Saturday 03:12 and the money lands in about four minutes. That sentence is the product.
narratives.VENUE_OUT_OF_APPETITE: No partner pairing carries offshore venues without UK recognition. Onshore venues are exactly why this flow is now serviceable.

source.description: USDC 12,400.00 realised PnL · positions closed 02:58 UTC
GBP 9,672.00 collected via Faster Payments from the trader's UK bank

facts.sourceOfFunds: UK bank account in the trader's name

narratives.APPROVED: Margin call at 03:00, collateral in the venue by 03:16. The trader keeps the position; the venue keeps the client.
Lands in about four minutes. Try the weekend to see why the SLA matters.
